svg.title: Nexus Play Studio — project card
svg.desc: Turns a PowerPoint lesson into a playable learning game. Claude drafts the learning map and blueprint, a human approves, and trusted templates build it. Built with Typescript, React, Fastify, Claude. Private project, more on the portfolio. Banner: a drawn illustration.
